name: Stättared - Veddige

estimatedTime.note: No official section-specific hiking time found. The official Hallandsleden page and API provide distance and difficulty only. At Hallandsleden's general planning pace of about 4 km/hour, 15 km implies about 3 h 45 min moving time, but this is not an official value and the red/hard grading reflects hilly and sometimes wet terrain.

difficulty.source: Hallandsleden section page and official API degree_of_difficulty=hard
difficulty.notes: Official copy describes easier forest road and country lane around the south end of Stora Hornsjön, then hillier terrain with narrow wet paths before an easier cycle-track approach into Veddige. Field reports and third-party listings for the older corridor also support a demanding red-grade character, but those reports predate or only partially overlap the 2024 reroute.

notes: Official order is Stättared to Veddige.
No ferry, rowboat, required bus-transfer segment, official loop, or official alternate was found for the current N4 section.
The section links N3 at Stättared to N5 at Veddige. The current official endpoint is Veddige station, not Dranstugan.

Several external and semi-official sources still frame the older Stättared - Dranstugan stage. Treat those as stale or adjacent-corridor context unless a later import phase explicitly models the Dranstugan side/legacy connection.
